name: High-temperature pyrolysis furnace

design.materialOfConstruction: Hot-zone UNS N06230 selected; Kanthal APMT retained as qualified alternative
design.heatingMode: Indirect (process fully isolated from heating elements)
design.retortGeometry: 0.90 m ID × 12 m heated retort (15 m overall); ≈ 0.85 m screw, 0.45 m pitch, 0.16 rpm — per module
design.installedHeatingDutyKw: 180 per module in six independent zones (× 3 modules)
design.offGasConnection: DN200 hot off-gas connection, 650 m³/h at 1,100 °C per module

operatingEnvelope.designInconsistencies: (1) 5 °C/min solids ramp cannot fit in a 4 h total residence; (2) deoxygenation is a fast exothermic gas burst complete by ≈ 300 °C while the anneal needs the length — pressure zones and control boundaries must be defined; (3) single rotary-kiln draft note is out of scope

reviewFindings: Draft +2 psig conflicts with slight negative pressure. Draft oxygen <10 ppm is an unqualified source claim, not an approved alarm, trip or operating limit. No pressure sign, oxygen threshold or permissive is selected.

Draft approximately 1100 degC, 4 h hold and 5 degC/min ramp are indicative only. Gas cooling 60-90 degC and product cooling 60-80 degC require qualification. Capacities, materials, gas composition and argon demand are unknown.

Draft considers KO/dust trap upstream of E-701; model KO-701 is downstream. Draft internal cooling zone differs from model-added E-702. Draft prior-to-cyclone note has no identified drawn/model cyclone; no cyclone is invented.

Normal gas connects to AB-3701 candidate only; treatment performance and permitted discharge remain unqualified. Model RV-701 differs from draft PSV-701. Relief destination, sizing and backpressure remain open and separate from normal treatment.

Draft is Not for Use with XXX revision. AR701/AR702 are draft stream identifiers, not confirmed equipment aliases for model AR-701. Air-fill dust vent and inert purge exhaust are distinct modes; purge, equalization, sampling and solids release sequences remain unqualified.

safety.hazardousClass: Zone 1 internal — H₂ service + combustible dust

identity.designConcept: Three identical indirectly electrically heated screw-furnace modules PY-701A/B/C, 46 kg/h dry feed each at 1,100 °C under argon, 4 h active-zone residence

safeguards.offGasBasis: CO 4–8 Nm³/h steady (× 3–5 in the burst), 8–10 vol % in Ar; water dew point 60–70 °C in E-701; entrained pyrophoric rGO fines — inert combustible dry gas, must be segregated from wet oxidising vents (S2 system)
